more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Dubai Sobha Hartland?

data.answer:
Residents enjoy a premium living experience in this prestigious residential community, surrounded by modern architecture and lush greenery. The residential units offer views of the s of the creek, canal, and the skyline of Dubai.

Public Transportation and Parking Spaces in Sobha Hartland Dubai

Dubai's public transportation system mainly comprises buses and the Dubai Metro. However, there might not be any direct routes to Sobha Hartland. You can still use these modes of transportation to reach nearby areas and then transfer to taxis or other means of transportation for the last part of your journey.

Parking spaces in Sobha Hartland are available outside the townhouses and villas, accommodating up to two cars per residence.

Supermarkets in Sobha Hartland

Several supermarkets are available in the Sobha Hartland location, including Gala Supermarket, Tudomart, Choithrams, and Urban Fresh Mini Mart. Additionally, residents have the option to visit a branch of Spinneys supermarkets in Dubai, conveniently located on 34th Street (D67).

Shopping in Sobha Hartland

Near Sobha Hartland, there are several well-known malls. Dubai Festival City Mall, situated in the established Festival City area, is particularly popular. It hosts a large IKEA and the only Robinsons department store in Dubai, along with numerous other retail and dining outlets. Accessible in approximately 16 minutes by car, it offers a diverse shopping and dining experience.

Dubai Mall, one of the largest malls in the Emirates, is a comprehensive destination for both tourists and residents. In addition to shopping, visitors can enjoy various entertainment options such as the Dubai Aquarium & Underwater Zoo, Dubai Ice Rink, and KidZania, among others. Souk Al Bahar, located opposite Dubai Mall and connected by a bridge over Burj Lake, offers an authentic Arabic-style shopping experience.

Schools Near Sobha Hartland

Near the Sobha Hartland location, parents have access to prestigious nurseries for their little ones, including Odyssey Nursery, Blossom Nursery, and Kinder Castle Nursery. Odyssey Nursery has a branch located within the premises of District One in Mohammed Bin Rashid Al Maktoum City. At this facility, students have the opportunity to express themselves through various art forms. Kinder Castle Nursery is situated at the Meydan Heights Retail Center, while Blossom Nursery has one of its branches on the ground floor of Building 2 in the Dubai Design District.

Furthermore, Sobha Hartland is home to several renowned schools, such as North London Collegiate School, Hartland International School, Latifa School for Girls, and Rashid Boys School. Families residing in Sobha Hartland are pleased to find two international schools within the community itself, along with many others located nearby. Notably, North London Collegiate School, just a 10-minute drive from the residential area, offers the International Baccalaureate (IB) curriculum from pre-primary to Grade 12. Similarly, Hartland International School, favored by many parents, provides both British and IB curriculums.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques near Sobha Hartland Area

Residents can easily access several mosques near Sobha Hartland, including Nad Al Sheba Grand Mosque, Al Sahabah Mosque, and Al Ain Way Mosque, all within approximately 10 10-minute drive. For those of the Christian faith, churches such as St. Mark & Ava Bishoy Coptic Orthodox Church, The Dubai City Church, Sharon Fellowship Church, and New Life Fellowship Dubai are reachable within about 13 minutes by car. Hindu residents can make their way to Sai Baba Temple Jumeirah in Jumeirah 1 within a 21-minute drive, while other temples in Bur Dubai are approximately 23 minutes away by car, depending on traffic conditions. Sikh residents will find Automech Gurudwara in Ras Al Khor accessible within a 12-minute drive.

Clinics and Hospitals near Sobha Hartland

Within Sobha Hartland and its surrounding areas, residents have access to a range of clinics and hospitals to cater to their healthcare needs. Emirates Hospital Day Surgery & Medical Center is located in Mohammed Bin Rashid Al Maktoum City, this facility provides outpatient services and medical consultations.

Situated at a 7-minute drive from the community, Nad Al Sheba Health Center offers primary healthcare services, including consultations with general practitioners and specialists. Al Jalila Children's Specialty Hospital is located in Al Jaddaf, about 20 minutes away from Sobha Hartland. The hospital specializes in pediatric healthcare, offering a wide range of medical services for children.

Sobha Hartland Location & Nearby Areas

Sobha Hartland offers a prime location with easy access to key areas of the city. Situated along the Dubai Canal and near Downtown Dubai, residents enjoy a picturesque waterfront setting and the vibrant cityscape. Nearby areas include Business Bay, Meydan, and Al Khail Road, providing convenient connectivity to major business hubs, leisure destinations, and transportation networks. Additionally, Sobha Hartland benefits from its proximity to schools, healthcare facilities, shopping malls, and entertainment venues, ensuring a well-rounded and convenient lifestyle for its residents.

more_info.question: Things to Do in Sobha Hartland Dubai

data.answer:
Sobha Hartland Dubai offers a plethora of activities and amenities for residents and visitors alike. Enjoy a wide range of recreational facilities, including swimming pools, fitness centers, tennis courts, and children's play areas, catering to all age groups and interests.

Restaurants near Sobha Hartland Dubai

Numerous dining establishments are conveniently located near Sobha Hartland, offering a variety of culinary experiences. These include Flave, Farriers, Cut in Half, The Track Restaurant, and Winner Circle Restaurant, all reachable within a 10-minute drive by car. Many of these options are situated in Dubai Design District, Downtown Dubai, and Business Bay.

Among the popular choices are Akiba Dori and Zen Restaurant in Dubai Design District, as well as 25 Degrees North and Lakeside Spice Restaurant in Business Bay, which specialize in Indian cuisine. Additionally, Downtown Dubai and Business Bay boast a plethora of dining options, ranging from casual eateries to upscale restaurants, ensuring there's something to suit every palate and occasion.

Beaches Near Akoya Sobha Hartland Location

The journey to the exquisite beaches near Sobha Hartland takes around 30 minutes, contingent upon road traffic. Jumeirah Beach offers a pristine stretch of sandy shoreline, where visitors can bask in the sun, swim in the azure waters, or partake in various water sports activities. Additionally, Sunset Beach, aptly named for its stunning sunset views, provides the perfect setting for romantic walks along the coast or peaceful moments of reflection as the sun dips below the horizon. Both beaches are popular among locals and tourists alike for their natural beauty and tranquil atmosphere, making them ideal destinations for relaxation and leisure.

Hotels near the Sobha Hartland Dubai Area

Within a 20-minute drive from Sobha Hartland, several hotels are offering luxurious accommodations and amenities, including The Meydan Hotel, Grand Hyatt Dubai, and The Ritz-Carlton. Situated adjacent to the Meydan Racecourse, The Meydan Hotel offers elegant rooms, fine dining options, and spectacular views of the Dubai skyline.

Located in the heart of Dubai's financial and entertainment district, Grand Hyatt Dubai features stylish rooms, multiple dining options, and extensive recreational facilities. The Ritz-Carlton, Dubai International Financial Centre: Nestled within the vibrant DIFC district, this upscale hotel boasts luxurious rooms, award-winning dining experiences, and a serene spa.

Attractions and Landmarks near Sobha Hartland

Exploring leisure activities near Sobha Hartland unveils a vibrant tapestry of attractions and experiences in the surrounding areas. From bustling shopping festivals to annual events and festive celebrations, there's always something exciting happening nearby. Landmarks such as The Track at Meydan Golf cater to golf enthusiasts seeking to perfect their swing, while the iconic Meydan Hotel stands tall as a beacon of luxury in Nad Al Sheba, offering chic nightlife venues like Qube Sports Bar and Soho Garden.

For a memorable weekend adventure, embark on a Dhow Cruise excursion along the Dubai Canal or indulge in delectable dining experiences at canal-side restaurants. Art aficionados will appreciate Tashkeel, a contemporary art center boasting work studios, exhibitions, and classes, as well as the Layal Art Gallery nestled in Nad Al Sheba 1, showcasing captivating artworks from local talents.

Outdoor Activities, Fitness, and Beauty

Near Sobha Hartland, you'll find a selection of fitness facilities conveniently located within a 20-minute drive, including Chisel N Stride, F45 Training, and Wellfit, offering various workout options to suit different preferences and fitness goals. Additionally, within a 15-minute drive, residents have access to popular salons such as L’instant Beauty Salon, Jb Joli et Belle Ladies Salon, and Simply Beauty Ladies Salon & Spa, ensuring convenient access to quality grooming services and relaxation treatments.

Although there are many advantages of living in Sobha Hartland, one of the things to consider is the access to public transport. Sobha Hartland have limited access to public transport options compared to more central areas, making it more reliant on private vehicles for transportation.

What district is Sobha Hartland?

Sobha Hartland is located within the district of Mohammed Bin Rashid Al Maktoum City (MBR City).

How big is Sobha Hartland 2?

Sobha Hartland 2 is a phase of the Sobha Hartland development, including a range of residential projects. The luxurious residential waterfront community sprawls across 8 million square feet, adorned with verdant greenery, communal gardens, and a plethora of amenities designed to foster a sustainable lifestyle.

When was Sobha Hartland launched? 

Sobha Hartland was introduced in phases, with initial phases commencing around 2015. By July 2021, Sobha Realty announced that the development had achieved a 50 percent completion milestone and was proceeding according to the schedule for handover by 2025. Construction of approximately 1,100 Sobha Hartland villas and apartments, spread across different phases, had been successfully completed by that time.

Who is Sobha Hartland's owner?

Sobha Hartland is developed by Sobha Realty, a leading real estate developer based in Dubai.

Is Sobha Hartland Freehold?

Yes, Sobha Hartland is a freehold area.

What are the top attractions in Sobha Hartland, Dubai?

Top attractions include the Hartland Greens, Hartland International School, and the nearby Dubai Water Canal.

How to get to Sobha Hartland in Dubai by bus and metro?

Take the Dubai Metro to the Business Bay station, then transfer to a bus or taxi for a short ride to Sobha Hartland.

Which are the best communities to live in Sobha Hartland, Dubai?

The best communities include Hartland Greens, Hartland Estates, and Hartland Waterfront.

What are the best hotels and restaurants in Sobha Hartland?

The best hotels and restaurants are primarily found in nearby areas like Downtown Dubai and Business Bay, offering luxurious accommodations and diverse dining options.

Which are the famous malls and supermarkets in Sobha Hartland?

Nearby famous malls include The Dubai Mall and Mall of the Emirates, while popular supermarkets include Carrefour and Spinneys.

What are the pros and cons of living in Sobha Hartland, Dubai?

Pros: Luxurious living, proximity to key attractions, top-notch amenities, and freehold properties.
Cons: Higher cost of living, ongoing construction, and limited public transport options within the community.

An 8 million sq. ft. waterfront community, Sobha Hartland houses luxurious apartments, villas, and townhouses. The highly anticipated and swiftly sought-after development is part of Mohammed Bin Rashid City. The Sobha Hartland master plan includes a mall, cafes and restaurants, schools, vast green spaces, swimming pools, and play areas.

The Sobha Hartland location between Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road (E311) and Al Khail Road (E44) provides convenient access to Mohammed Bin Rashid City.

This exclusive community offers a harmonious blend of serene natural surroundings, modern architecture, and a vibrant lifestyle, making it a sought-after destination for discerning homeowners.

This architectural masterpiece offers a curated collection of 1 to 4-bedroom apartments.
